text:
julia (Finance): Heads-up: starting 2026-05-01 we're changing hosted metered invoicing to a daily cutover at 00:00 UTC and updating how leftover free credits are reflected. Aim: fewer surprise EOM invoices and better daily visibility.

julia (Finance): Key points:
- Daily invoice aggregation window at 00:00 UTC (instead of single EOM batch).
- Remaining monthly free credits will be converted to a `carry_forward_free_credit` line item and prorated across the new daily windows.
- The temporary soft-grace buffer for overages is being removed; overages billed at standard per-unit rates.
- Reserved/Dedicated committed plans: no change to billing cadence.

omar (Billing): Question: requests that span the cutover (23:59 -> 00:01) — any dedupe?

tara (Eng): We'll add `billing-window-id` to request logs and dedupe on request UUID at cutover. Eng will run a cutover test in staging.

kevin (Revenue Ops): AMs want per-route lines to remain for reconciliation.

julia (Finance): Yes — per-route and per-model breakdowns remain. New invoice fields: `billing_run_id`, `window_start`, `window_end`, and `carry_forward_free_credit`.

omar (Billing): What about refunds for customers who recently prepaid monthly credits?

julia (Finance): No automatic refunds. For qualifying customers we can issue account credits equivalent to unused portions; AMs can escalate for exceptions. We'll publish eligibility rules.

billing-bot: migration_ticket_2310000000 scheduled -> status: queued, ETA: 48h. :gear:

kevin (Revenue Ops): I'll draft customer comms and AM talking points (why invoice looks different, where credits show up). Expect first draft tomorrow.

julia (Finance): Action items:
- Finance: publish full docs + sample invoices by 2026-04-12.
- Billing: add `billing_run_id` to exports and update invoice schema by 2026-04-10.
- Eng: run dedupe / cutover tests and disable mirrored-metering during migration window by 2026-04-11.
- Revenue Ops & AMs: finalize customer comms and support scripts by 2026-04-13.

julia (Finance): We'll host office hours 2026-04-09 16:00 UTC in #announcements-office-hours to walk through sample invoices. Ping me for urgent exceptions. :thumbsup:
